event.description: Union closest shared FF-output scalar groups 89 and 127
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,551 parameters at 99.020000%, a +0.020000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 68 prior macro-attempts in this family and 589 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0170/micro-0014 at 1,552 parameters and 99.01%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0170/micro-0015 (FF-output pair 10/223 discarded at 98.95%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 89 and 127, values 0.0070689167 and 0.0075896727 (difference 5.208e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,550 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 5.252e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
